result.summary: 퇴사점검은 회사가 이직확인서에 11번(개인사정 자진퇴사)을 찍어 실업급여가 막힌 퇴사자를 위한 휴대폰 크기의 웹입니다. 가입 없이 자기 퇴사 사정을 고용보험법 시행규칙 별표 2의 정당한 이직 사유와 자기 날짜와 숫자로 대조해 수급 가능성과 근거 조문을 보고, 회사에 보낼 이직확인서 발급·정정 요청서와 고용센터에 낼 진술서 틀, 증빙 목록을 받아 가게 합니다.
result.said: 시안 봤고 좋아보이는데, 너무 단조로워보이는 느낌도 있어요. 한가지색만 쓰는데 원색이라 쨍한느낌이랄까.
decided: The design contract marks feel [반증됨] with the owner's words from 2026-11-21, and there is no .sz/spec.md, so the design stage is "again". Nothing was planned, and no spec, map or progress line was written. The screens get drawn again first.
I did not run `sz-eyes ios room` and set no simulators count. The product is a phone-size web page (the starting session's note says 형태는 휴대폰 크기의 웹), so no part of it is a native app.
`sz-eyes sandbox` said this session is sandboxed. Whoever opens a browser next has to run that command outside the sandbox from the first try.

changed: The owner said it feels monotonous because there is only one colour ("너무 단조로워보이는 느낌도 있어요. 한가지색만 쓰는데"). I added a second colour, a lemon highlighter, `--accent` #EEDF78. The prototype is .sz/design/prototype.html. The new colour has its own job: the pen colour marks what the person wrote, the highlighter marks the lines the law draws, and the law's own text stays ink black. Three new tokens were added: --accent, --accent-soft (derived with color-mix) and --on-accent. Five parts now use the highlighter, so every screen built from them changed with them. (1) .gauge .mark: the law's threshold line on the answer band is now a 3px highlighter line, and its label (기준 60일) is ink text on a highlighter patch. (2) .cite .law: the law-reference link is now a highlighter chip. (3) .tile.law: the article-number tiles on CR-01 now have a highlighter background. (4) .timeline .pt.law: a new class that colours the company-deadline dot on NX-01, NX-01-sent and HM-01. (5) .hl: a new highlighter stroke for legal thresholds written inside sentences. The .hl stroke is used in these places: on ST-01, the four 'law's lines' tiles (2개월, 왕복 3시간, 30일, 권고 기록) and the '상실사유 코드' label on the drawn form; in the subtitles of CK-02 (18개월 안에, 180일) and CK-04 (이직일 전 1년 안에, 2개월 이상); and on CR-01 (1년 안에 2개월 이상, 왕복 3시간 이상, 30일 이상, 8세 이하…). The highlighted article line on RS-02 moved from the pen-colour tint to the highlighter tint. The white override on the citation chip on RS-01-short was removed so it follows the part. The labels now take a little more room, so the space above the bar went from 30 to 34px (RS-01 26 to 32px, CK-02 30 to 34px). Layout, wording and screens are unchanged.

The owner said the colour is a pure primary and looks harsh ("원색이라 쨍한느낌"). The pen colour `--brand` went from #2F4CC4 to a muted ink blue, #3B5690 (oklch .46 .10 264, about half the original saturation .19). White text on it is 7.2:1. Every colour derived from it (pressed, soft, its lines, text on the band, the empty track) follows through color-mix, and the fixed fallbacks were recomputed. In the colour picker (both swatch rows at the top of the overview and the parts screen), the rejected #2F4CC4 is no longer offered. The pen options are now 잉크 #3B5690 (my choice), 먹남 #24386E (unchanged) and a muted 자두 #7B4263 (was #86356F). A second row of swatches picks the highlighter: 레몬 #EEDF78 (my choice) or 분홍 #F7B5C8. The choice is kept across a reload and can be set in the address with ?c=…&a=….
The plan in .sz/plan/ is unchanged: the owner said nothing that adds, drops or reorders a screen.

I measured as the skill says. All 31 drawings in .sz/design/screens.txt held twice (0 findings above minor). Pressed through, the main flow went ST-01 → CK-01 → CK-02 → CK-03 → CK-04 → RS-01 → NX-01 → DC-02 with every step passing, and so did the law link CK-04 → RS-02. All pictures in .sz/design/shots/ were retaken. CK-04 was also shot in each alternative colour: CK-04-ink-phone.png, CK-04-plum-phone.png and CK-04-pink-phone.png (new).

I corrected .sz/design/direction.md to match what is drawn. The idea sentence now names three roles: the law's text in ink, the law's lines in highlighter, what the person wrote in pen. Also updated: the description of the first screen; the colour row of the table; principle 2; the colour-choice section (owner's words quoted, two tables of options with contrast ratios, what was left out and why); a note on the reference's highlighter band; a new log entry for this round; and, for the builder, the token block (--brand #3B5690, --accent, --accent-soft, --on-accent), the colour rule, the parts table (.hl, .pt.law, and what changed in .gauge, .cite and .tile.law) and the prototype-only ?a=.
couldNot: Whether the lemon highlighter stays clearly apart from the amber 'more to check' badge (cream #FBEED3) is a judgement for the owner's eye. To keep them apart, the highlighter is never used as a badge, and pink is offered as the alternative.

The reference board had said not to copy PocketCU's highlighter band. That band sits under the answer total, in the brand's lavender. Ours marks the law's thresholds, never the answer, and in a separate lemon colour. This is noted in direction.md, but it is a judgement call.
